**Binary MiB**, despite the field being named `max_file_size_mb`.

The validator converts it with Rails’ `.megabytes` and rejects files only when `document.file_size > limit`: [validate_documents.rb](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:111).

For a vendor limit of **50 MiB**, set `max_file_size_mb: 50`. This permits up to **52,428,800 bytes**, inclusive—not decimal 50,000,000 bytes.
